spans.s: मङ्कणक m. N. of a Ṛṣi & a Yakṣa.
मङ्कि m. N. of a man.
मङ्कु॑ a. tottering, reeling.
मङ्क्तव्य n. impers. to be dived.
मङ्क्षु adv. instantly, directly.
मङ्ख m. a man's name.
मङ्ग m. pl. N. of a people.

मङ्गलकरण (& कर्मन्*) n. prayer for success
(lit. luck-causing act).
मङ्गलकलश s. auspicious pot or vase.*
मङ्गलगृह (& क*) n. auspicious chamber or house.
मङ्गलतूर्य n. festive instrument.
मङ्गलसमालम्भन n. auspicious unguent.*

मङ्गलवचस् n. ˚शब्द m. benedictory speech,
congratulation.
मङ्गलाचार m. auspicious custom or ceremony.
मङ्गलादेशवृत्त m. fortune-teller.

मङ्गलार्थम्^1 adv. for the sake of good fortune.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160418. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/289. note: cf. MW. Adv. with accusative form ending in 'm'.
मङ्गलीय a. auspicious.
मङ्गलोद्गीत n. festive song.*

मङ्गल्य a. lucky, auspicious, festive, solemn, holy. m. &
f. आ names of sev. plants;
 n. anything auspicious or of good omen,
esp. a prayer.

माङ्गल्य a. & n. = prec., n. also benediction, auspicious
ceremony or festival.
मङ्गिनी f. boat, ship.
मङ्गीर m. names of men.
मङ्गु m. names of men.
